title: Power found holding destinies close. Moirae's Gentle touch opens scales to sound birds escaping Wings beat in percussive flicks of life fit in fingers
summary: Power found holding destinies close. Moirae's Gentle touch opens scales to sound birds escaping Wings beat in percussive flicks of life fit in fingers cutting against time. #smallpoems #ukulele
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Power found
holding destinies
close.
   Moirae's
Gentle
     touch
opens
scales
to sound birds
escaping
Wings beat
in percussive
  flicks of life
fit in fingers
  cutting against
time.
#smallpoems
#ukulele
